mentions.name: TCPFinMonitor
mentions.description: This tool tracks TCP FIN packet timing to show how upstream connections are closing and how keep-alives behave, helping spot connections that close too early or time out, such as those causing Envoy 503 errors.
mentions.problem: The authors hit an Envoy 503 bug in production and needed quick tools to figure out what was happening with TCP connections and HTTP requests.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://github.com/vishnugt/TCPFinMonitor.  Live - https://keepalive.gt.ms/

This tool tracks TCP FIN packet timing to see how upstream connections are closing and how keep-alives behave. It helped me spot when connections were closing too early or timing out, which was causing those 503 errors.
